project_type: Next.js 15.5 app router EHR (React 19, TS, Tailwind), AWS SDK v3, Chime SDK
build_system: pnpm 9.15.9 (pinned via corepack); sandbox has NO network so pnpm install/next build/tsc cannot run; node 22 present
test_framework: node:test files in tests/ (*.test.ts, *.test.mjs); many are source-string assertions via fs.readFileSync
verification_instructions: Run any node:test files that can run offline; otherwise careful static review. Amplify build is authoritative.
environment_constraints: No AWS credentials, no network, no node_modules. Cannot push. Live Chime/SES/Transcribe verification impossible.
contribution_requirements: Do not move/remove existing features; trace regressions to known-good commits via git history; honest evidence only.
key_patterns: Hand-signed SES v2 REST in lib/ehr/ses-send.ts; patient invite in lib/ehr/patient-invite-email.ts; clients API app/api/ehr/clients/route.ts (resendInvitation action); UI in app/ehr/full-production-interface.tsx (resendPatientInvitation ~L4272, Send Intake Package button ~L4470); telehealth in app/ehr/native-telehealth-room.tsx and app/api/ehr/telehealth/route.ts
directory_structure: app/ (routes, ehr UI), lib/ehr (server helpers), tests/, docs/, .agents/tasks/ (history)
